description: A placed instance of a `kind: "python"` project widget (`desk_widgets/<name>/widget.py`) no longer hot-reloads when you edit its source. Its titlebar shows `[STALE]` instead (a content hash of the whole widget directory differs from the one it was placed with, and it survives a Desk restart); the user clicks it to rebuild that instance, which also discards the instance's in-memory state. Built-in widgets still hot-reload. Edits to modules outside `desk_widgets/<name>/` are not hashed.
